rationale: The statistical core matches the design well: DESeq2 Wald on ~condition with the control level set explicitly from the reported level names, unpaired 3v3, no spurious batch term, honest statements about instability of dispersion and wide log2FC intervals at n=3, and an edgeR QL-F replication as a genuine second estimator. QC, filtering, normalization inside the model, BH with apeglm shrinkage (unshrunken p-values retained for inference), and ranked-list GSEA with a stated metric, human-only collections, a 15-500 size window and leading-edge redundancy collapsing are all specified concretely and tied to this dataset. The weakness relative to the reference is the strandedness handling: the plan confronts the issue seriously and refuses to trust the matrix blindly, but it substitutes a circumstantial count-matrix diagnostic (GTEx liver profile correlation, detection rates, marker CPMs) for an actual strandedness inference (RSeQC infer_experiment.py or salmon libType A) and explicitly forecloses re-counting by declaring reads unavailable, so a wrong -s setting can be flagged but never corrected; the sensitivity analysis in T1S3 mitigates but does not replace this. Reporting is otherwise thorough — design, thresholds, filtered/tested/significant counts, plots, caveats — though software versions are not named as a deliverable.
